name: Grouped MCP unread activity
description: Assess stable activity changes after a complete observation of current unread state.
prompt:
Compare the retained before and current revisions to identify new or changed incoming activity for account keys outlook:work, teams:work and gmail:personal. Re-read the current Hive result object collector-result-object-id. Require data.observation.complete to be true and data.observation.observedAt to be no more than 180 seconds old. If evidence is unavailable, incomplete or stale, record that limitation and return no notification.

Use public Outlook, Teams and Gmail MCP read tools to retrieve the changed messages and relevant conversation context. Verify that the activity is still unread and unresolved. Assess consequential requests, deadlines and materially useful new information. An unread count or a newly shared link alone does not justify a notice. Include the sender, source, relevant original text and useful native links in any notice.

Return the Secretary decision and let Secretary apply its contact rules. Source-account access is limited to reading; sending, replying and modifying messages are outside this assignment.
